name: grimmsnarl_ml_v15
policy: v14 exactly, plus one hard invariant: a turn never passes with a reachable, worthwhile Shadow Bullet unplayed. The escape attachment and the retreat it buys are already v8's two highest-scored rules; v15 makes the ranker respect them.

attack_access.problem: ready_grimms() answers whether a Grimmsnarl ex can pay Shadow Bullet; nothing answered whether it can reach the Active spot this turn. _active_can_retreat() reads only attached Energy, so Active Snorunt 0E + Darkness in hand + unused manual attachment + Bench-ready Grimmsnarl reads as no attack this turn.
attack_access.route: attach one Darkness to the Active -> retreat -> promote the ready Grimmsnarl -> Shadow Bullet
attack_access.why_one_attachment_is_enough: every non-Grimmsnarl body this deck plays retreats for exactly one Energy (Impidimp, Morgrem, Snorunt, Froslass, Munkidori = 1; Grimmsnarl ex = 2)
teeth: ACCESS: force the next ETA-0 route step (escape attachment, or the retreat it paid for, or fuelling an Active Grimmsnarl that is one Energy short)
CONVERT: never END with a worthwhile Shadow Bullet legal
BRIDGE: never END when v8's own scoring would attack (Filch / Corkscrew Punch)
PROMOTE: after our own retreat, put the ready Grimmsnarl in the Active spot
fires_only_when: the route completes this turn: escape debt <= 1 Energy, manual attachment unused, not already retreated, Active not asleep or paralysed
the Shadow Bullet is worth something: real damage to their Active, or a Bench-30 that takes a prize now
the chosen action does not already reach an attack this turn (attack, retreat, attachment to the Active, Grimmsnarl ex evolve onto the Active, or the Rare Candy that does)

subset_of_v8.note: both forced steps are v8's own top-scored rules; the guard adds three conditions v8 does not check, so it fires on strictly fewer boards than v8's rules apply to

attack_access.stickiness: the route is recomputed from the board every decision, so paying the escape debt is what turns the next step from attach into retreat. The only cross-decision state is a one-shot promotion flag.

router.information: opponent active, bench, discard, pre-evolutions and stadium only

residual.board_condition: the opponent took no prize during their last turn, and no Unfair Stamp is already in hand

wall_guard.interaction_with_attack_access: the route's worth gate is the wall guard's own gate, so a damage-immune Active with no Bench prize keeps v14's behaviour: no forced retreat into a wall, and no forced Shadow Bullet

deliberately_unchanged.deck: same 60 cards; the same list is rated 1151.0, 1116.3 and 1113.7 on the current board, so the deck is not the bottleneck
deliberately_unchanged.punk_search_budget: Punk Up draws from the deck and only reaches Marnie's Pokemon, so it can never pay a Snorunt or Munkidori escape; the fitted elite-band budget is kept
deliberately_unchanged.bosses_orders: 79% of v14's Boss plays attack the same turn and 63% take a prize, at or above the rank-3 pilot
deliberately_unchanged.unfair_stamp: 90% attack the same turn, 53% take a prize
deliberately_unchanged.petrel: 74% attack the same turn, 46% take a prize
deliberately_unchanged.froslass: identical 0.93 per game in v14's wins and losses; no outcome signal to act on
deliberately_unchanged.zero_damage_shadow_bullet: the rank-3 pilot plays about 2.8 a game in wall matchups; not banned
deliberately_unchanged.grimmsnarl_line_count: v14 already evolves 2.21 a game against their 1.95, and more in losses than in wins
deliberately_unchanged.per_decision_search: v12's whole-turn arithmetic search stays removed
deliberately_unchanged.teacher_averaging: no new model; the v9 four-teacher consensus stays unpackaged

promotion_gate.primary_kpi: first Shadow Bullet turn, and the share of games with one by our own turn 2
promotion_gate.demoted_kpi: first attack turn (Filch and Corkscrew Punch counted as attacks and hid the gap)
promotion_gate.counterfactual: GRIMMSNARL_ROUTE_DISABLE=1 must reproduce v14 decision for decision
promotion_gate.ladder_gate: Rating drift >= 0 over at least 50 games started from 1000+, not a peak
promotion_gate.rejected_gate: peak rating, and win rate against a lower-rated opponent pool

next_candidates_not_in_this_version: two-turn prize planner over Shadow Bullet's Bench-30, Adrena-Brain, Froslass and Boss's Orders
orphan-damage measurement: how much Bench-30 ever becomes a prize
distinct backup attacker ETA <= 1 at end of turn
matchup residuals trained on actual matchup trajectories, and DAgger over our own failure states
description: One falsifiable change over v14: the agent may no longer end a turn with a Shadow Bullet it could have reached. The route it forces is v8's own highest-priority rule pair, gated to boards where the route completes this turn and the attack is worth making.
